summary: NRX Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement with BTIG for a public offering of 5,714,286 shares at $3.50/share, with a 30-day over-allotment option for 857,142 additional shares. Estimated net proceeds are ~$18.8M ($21.6M if option exercised). The offering closed on June 4, 2026, under an effective shelf registration statement (Form S-3). Directors and officers agreed to a 60-day lock-up. This is a routine capital raise under a shelf registration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic review is involved.
